ValidationRule.description: Average transit speed (miles per hour from DISTANCE and transit seconds) must be below 600 mph, and Ground service below 80 mph.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Origin__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Destination__latitude__s)), NULLVALUE(Transit_Seconds__c, 0) > 0, DISTANCE(Origin__c, Destination__c, 'mi') / (Transit_Seconds__c / 3600) > IF(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Ground'), 80, 600) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Transit time is physically implausible for the distance and service level.
